## Addendum (author decisions), recorded 2026-11-17T14:46:45Z (UTC), before any fresh study is coded
- P2 refers to claims in at least one endorsed relation of any type (backs, clashes or covers). The shares via backs and via covers will also be reported separately (roadmap item 10), without a prediction.
- Failure thresholds:
  - P1 fails if the median number of joint claims per study is outside 2-4.
  - P2 fails if the pooled share of headline claims related to another claim is below 40% or above 60%.
  - P3 fails if any study states a clash between two of its headline claims (an endorsed relation of type clashes under rule 4).
